_comment: Optional real photos for player cards, keyed by player id (the "id" field in the generated player_profiles.json — find a player's id there, not their name, since that file regenerates from the sheet). Value: "/players/<file>.jpg" (square photo for the avatar circle), or {"card": "/players/<file>.jpg", "portrait": "/players/<file>-portrait.jpg"} to also show a tall 4:5 photo big on that player's own page. Images go in public/players/. Read by src/lib/player-photos.ts. Hand-edited, never touched by scripts/update_data.py.
